name: 97367 · Lincoln City, OR
findings: ZIP 97367 (Lincoln City) has 27 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 7 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97367 (Lincoln City) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
